revision_note: Supersedes the initial Phase-0 record. The first detection pass ran without sourcing /opt/xilinx/xrt/setup.sh and /tools/Xilinx/Vitis/2023.2/settings64.sh, and therefore wrongly concluded that no FPGA toolchain or board was present. The full Vitis 2023.2 toolchain, the U55C platform, and a ready physical card are all available. Tiers T1-T3 are achievable.

fpga_toolchain.note: Both the Vitis settings64.sh and the XRT setup.sh must be sourced before any tool invocation; scripts/env.sh does both and pins the platform path. Device resource counts are in results/device.json, queried from the Vivado part database.

software.python_venv: .venv (python3.11 via bootstrapped pip + virtualenv; the system default python3 is 3.8.10 and cannot import sinter>=1.9)

provenance_tier_ceiling.software_experiments: T4 for Monte Carlo logical-error-rate estimation (Stim simulation is by definition a simulation); host-CPU decoder throughput/latency are real measurements on the CPU described above
provenance_tier_ceiling.hls_estimates: T3 achievable (Vitis HLS 2023.2 C-synthesis and cosim)
provenance_tier_ceiling.hardware: T1 achievable (physical U55C at 0000:8c:00.1 via XRT 2.15.225)
